source.description: PROBLEM: bd memories retires in favor of our own system. Specialists side mapped (unitAI-s9adh, S0-S8); their S6-S7 park on core S0. SUCCESS: core inventory + sequential removal with tree green each step; S0 (Stop gate retired) announced to hint-lane to unblock their S6-S7; memory export landed before deletions. SCOPE: map then remove core bd-memory hooks/extension/gate/docs/tests; export live memories first. NON_GOALS: replacement memory system design; specialists-repo edits; deleting history docs. CONSTRAINTS: close flows must keep working at every step (gate removed before code it guards, per s9adh ordering); backup .xtrm/memory.md + export Dolt memories before delete; no origin-mutating actions without approval.
